en.title: Xbox Unleashes Alligator Series X Console Before GTA 6 Drops
en.summary: In a wild move before the highly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto VI, Xbox is giving fans a chance to win a truly unique, custom-built Xbox Series X console shaped like a life-sized alligator.
en.body:
With **Grand Theft Auto VI** mere weeks away from its November 19, 2026, launch, the gaming world is abuzz with anticipation for Rockstar's return to Vice City. In a move that perfectly captures the vibrant, and sometimes dangerous, wildlife of the game’s fictional Leonida setting, **Xbox** has unveiled a one-of-a-kind **Xbox Series X** console. Dubbed the **Xbox Series X-Bite**, this impressive creation is a fully functional, 5-foot-long replica of an alligator, complete with a custom **Xbox controller** nestled menacingly in its jaws.

The console’s design is remarkably convincing, appearing almost like a piece of genuine taxidermy, but thankfully, it's a meticulously crafted prop. **Xbox** partnered with **John Nolan Studio**, the same special effects wizards behind Netflix's **The Witcher**, **Jurassic World Dominion**, and the upcoming **Harry Potter** series for HBO, to bring this reptilian gaming rig to life. The attention to detail is striking; the power button is discreetly placed on the gator's back, and even the pupils of its eyes are shaped like the iconic Xbox 'X', outlined in the brand's signature green.

## A Gator-Sized Giveaway

This isn't just a static display piece destined for a Microsoft showroom. Starting November 3, 2026, fans have the opportunity to win this extraordinary **Xbox Series X-Bite** console for themselves through a special sweepstakes. To enter, participants need to follow the official **@XBOX** account on their preferred social media platform (X, Instagram, or TikTok), ensure their profile is public, and repost the designated sweepstakes announcement post with the hashtag **#XbiteSweepstakes**. It’s a straightforward entry process for a console that is anything but ordinary.

## Competition and Community

The timing of this giveaway is particularly shrewd. With **GTA 6** dominating conversations and PlayStation already making its presence felt in marketing, **Xbox** is employing a creative counter-strategy. While **Xbox** hasn't explicitly linked the console to **GTA 6** in their announcements, the connection is undeniable. The **Xbox Series X-Bite** serves as a fun, thematic nod to the game's setting, offering a unique piece of gaming memorabilia that celebrates the excitement surrounding one of the most anticipated game launches in history. It’s a clever way to capture attention and engage the passionate gaming community.

## What's Next

The sweepstakes runs until 11:59 PM PT on November 10, 2026. The lucky winner will have 48 hours to claim their prize, with the console making a "clean getaway" if unclaimed. The giveaway is open to legal residents of the 50 U.S. and D.C., aged 18 and older. Fans worldwide will be watching to see who snags this incredible, gator-shaped piece of gaming history before they dive into **GTA 6**.

content_raw: GTA 6 is mere weeks away from launch, and to celebrate, Xbox is bringing the wildlife of Leonida to players’ living rooms with a one-of-a-kind console. The Xbox Series X-Bite, as it’s been affectionately dubbed by the company, is a 5-foot-long, alligator-shaped, fully functional Xbox Series X. It’s quite convincing, actually, and it even looks like a piece of genuine taxidermy. Thankfully, that’s not the case; this life-sized fake alligator was created in partnership with John Nolan Studio, which created special effects for Netflix’s The Witcher series, Jurassic World Dominion , and HBO’s upcoming Harry Potter show. To turn on the console, simply push the Xbox button on the gator’s back; it’s got a controller placed carefully in its jaws, bearing tooth marks as proof of its ravenous appetite. Even the pupils in its eyes are shaped like an X, outlined in green in keeping with Xbox branding. This strange blend of technology and artwork isn’t an avante-garde installation sitting in the Microsoft corporate offices; starting today, November 3, fans can enter a sweepstakes to win the quirky console for themselves. Here’s how to participate: Follow @XBOX on your platform of choice. (X, Instagram, or TikTok) Your profile must be public. Repost the designated XBOX sweepstakes post. Manually add #XbiteSweepstakes to your repost. The sweepstakes lasts until 11:59pm PT on November 10, 2026. The lucky winner will have 48 hours to claim the console; if they fail to do so, the gator will “make a clean getaway.” Additionally, the sweepstakes is only open to legal residents of the 50 U.S. and D.C. who are 18 years of age or older. While Xbox didn’t directly mention GTA 6 in its posts about this unique contest, it’s hard not to see why it was made; the game takes place in a fictional version of Florida, which, as most folks will know, is home to all sorts of critters, including alligators. (It’s unclear if players will be able to wrassle gators bare-handed like they do in real-life Florida, but we figure the X-Bite is the next best thing.) GTA 6 launches on November 19 on PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S. (Or the X-Bite.) Just this morning, its install size and global release times were revealed, with preload dates also confirmed for November 9 and 10. Given that the file size is 212 GB, Rockstar has urged players to preload the game on their consoles as soon as they can. “Make sure you've got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible,” Rockstar said on the game’s official website. Fans are more keen than ever to get their hands on a copy of GTA 6, to the point where oodles of IGN’s readers are actually calling out of work to play it . A separate survey from Unwind Media even shared some concerning statistics that showed a baffling amount of players are so desperate to play the game early that they would even give up their pets if that meant they could experience it a week before launch.
